title: Deterministic INDEX_m channel and scorer controls
purpose: Exercise the task, role boundary, oracle policies, per-episode cost record, and aggregator without loading or calling an LLM. This does not test a language or an LLM communication capability.

conditions.agents: receiver returns 0 without receiving the sender vector
conditions.expected_reference: 0.5 accuracy in expectation; report this finite pilot's exact count

conditions.agents: central deterministic evaluator receives both private views and returns x_i
deterministic sender transmits all m bits; deterministic receiver selects x_i
conditions.expected_reference: 16/16 exact; m ASCII payload bytes per episode, before framing

conditions.agents: receiver sends a fixed-width binary index; sender returns the selected bit
conditions.expected_reference: 16/16 exact; ceil(log2(m))+1 ASCII payload bytes per episode, before framing

metrics: runner wall and process CPU seconds
interpretation_limits: This verifies only deterministic task/channel/scorer plumbing and the cost-record path.
Oracle success does not imply that any LLM role can perform the sender or receiver operation.
No language, protocol superiority, scaling, or cross-model transfer claim is licensed.
ASCII payload bytes are not model-token counts or a direct bit-cost estimate for natural-language protocols.
